query_text: what structure makes up the middle ear

messages.content: what structure makes up the middle ear

message.content:
The **middle ear** is made up of an air-filled space behind the eardrum and the **three ossicles**: the **malleus**, **incus**, and **stapes**.[1][3][4]

It also includes the **Eustachian tube** and is bounded by the tympanic membrane on the outside and the oval window on the inner side.[2][4][6]
